title: MZ Plugin that allows you to use dialogue written in another program in RPG Maker ?

posts.author: Cicadawing
posts.body:
My game is going to be dialogue heavy, but I cannot get used to RPG Maker's dialogue creation for some reason. I was hoping there was a plugin that allowed me to write dialogue in another program, like Twine or Crochet, and then plug it into RPG Maker.
I've heard of the Yardspinner plugin before, but Yarnspinner doesn't have a download for some reason? Only one for Unity, but I'm not using Unity.
Any suggestions would be great! This is also my forum post so please forgive me if i mess anything up.

Wow, I messed this post up already...
Yup! it is "Yarnspinner!" It's a dialogue making system that several games have used, but the only one I know off the top of my head is Night in the Woods.
As for the plugin if you're interested, here it is:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/pixelmaps-yarn-spinner-plugin-mz.153762/
